description: This .25 course will engage students in mentoring, guided inquiry, and reflection to explore how a
high-impact experiential learning experience (internships and student employment; study
abroad/away, civic and community engagement; undergraduate research; leadership experience)
connects to their developing vocational identity. Students explore readings, videos, and
first-hand experiences about fundamental concepts of vocation and experiential learning.
Prerequisite: Completed or concurrent participation in a high-impact experiential learning
practice (internships and student employment; study abroad/away, civic and community engagement;
undergraduate research; leadership experience) with instructor permission.
